build_blip2_retriever_model: build a BLIP2 retrieval model with vision backbone, text backbone, and multimodal backbone for image-text retrieval
extract_multimodal_features: extract image or text features from a BLIP2 retriever model using the _extract_feat method
compute_itc_itm_lm_loss: compute ITC, ITM, and LM losses for a batch of image-text pairs during training
compute_i2t_similarity_matrix: compute an image-to-text similarity score matrix for retrieval between images and texts
compute_t2i_similarity_matrix: compute a text-to-image similarity score matrix for retrieval between texts and images
